name: West Entrance to Mushroom Town
terrain_style: grassySoil tileset (layers 0 and 2): bright green grass fringe on top of olive/khaki-brown cobbled dirt with scattered grey embedded stones; solid earth blocks with vertical cliff faces. Sky backdrop: grassySoil back 0-3,5,6 (blue sky, cumulus clouds, distant hill with mushroom house under a big tree, leafy tree, meadow strips).

landmarks.what: Orange mushroom house with yellow spots (houseGS/house6 body)
Orange spotted mushroom cap of the house (house6 basic/1 + deco/0)
Mushroom-awning front door frame + plank door (door/9, door/11)
Large green bush/tree (Heena stands on its top, T6)
Tiny mushroom cluster at foot of the steps
Green bush at foot of steps
Ladder up the laundry plateau face
Clothesline: two Y-shaped wooden posts + rope (rope is foothold T9)
Hanging trousers and white sheet on clothesline

notes: Portals recovered from raw WZ because the parsed API JSON has null entries: https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Map/Map0/000000000.img/portal/<n> (fields pn, pt, tm, tn, x, y). All portals here are therefore sourced, not inferred.

Landmark x,y are WZ obj anchors from https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Map/Map0/000000000.img/<layer>/obj/<n>; sprites identified via https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Obj/<oS>.img/<l0>/<l1>/<l2>/0. API-reported sprite origins were all exactly (w/2,h/2), so treat anchors as roughly sprite-centre; footprints are +-half sprite size. Where one landmark merges several objects, x,y is their approximate mean.
tiers[].y_left/y_right are MapleStory y (down is positive). Tier ids are local to this file. Ladders: y1 = top end, y2 = bottom end (raw data order); from_tier = bottom tier, to_tier = top tier.
v8 has zero mob spawns in this map (life contains only NPCs).
Spawn points (pt 0 "sp") x4 at (-206,102),(-162,103),(-127,101),(-112,101): above the west end of T1.
T6 (Heena) is 120 px above T1 and T9 (clothesline) is ~73 px above T5; neither has a ladder. T7/T8 barrel tops are 48-55 px above T1.

T5 is layer 0 while T1-T4 are layer 2; T5 west face is a wall at x=726 spanning y=125..390, which crosses the T4 walkway (y=365). out00 (1052,365) and the ladder foot (975,363) lie east of that face, so the design requires T4 to pass in front of the plateau.

v22 differs (docs/research/raw/gms_v22/0.json): west plateau at y=485 rising via steps 425 -> 365 (inverted relative to v8), Heena perch at y=305, sp at y~437-452; east half identical; v22 raw WZ out00 at (1116,365) -> 10000:in00 (https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/22/Map/Map/Map0/000000000.img/portal/4).
